Охранный датчик ViON на ESP32-CAM: замеч: A ViON security sensor on an ESP32-CAM: notices movement in a room by the Wi-Fi signal, without video. The board is found in the network by itself and is set up and updated from ViON; its camera is optional.
Sensors are found in the network by them: Sensors are found in the network by themselves. If yours does not appear in Sensors, Found, type its address here (several separated by commas), e.g. 192.168.1.50.
Where the list of firmware versions is r: Where the list of firmware versions is read from.
How many times the Wi-Fi signal has to c: How many times the Wi-Fi signal has to change more than in an empty room. Lower is more sensitive and gives more false alarms.
How long the sensor stays in motion afte: How long the sensor stays in motion after the last movement.
The sensor learns the empty room for 30: The sensor learns the empty room for 30 seconds: leave the room before pressing.
The board forgets the Wi-Fi and this ViO: The board forgets the Wi-Fi and this ViON and shows its own network for a new setup.
How readily a person standing still coun: How readily a person standing still counts as present (the Espressif algorithm). Higher is more sensitive.
Which algorithm of the board makes motio: Which algorithm of the board makes motion in ViON. Both run all the time: switch to compare them.
The new firmware did not start, and the: The new firmware did not start, and the board went back to the one it had.
